faqIntro: A few things people in the UK and Europe ask before they commission a landing page.
faq: What's in The Gherkin and The Full Jar?

The Gherkin is €99. It is a custom-designed landing page for a product, a service, or a personal brand: message, structure, design and build, ready for mobile, speed, and search foundations. Hosting is not included. The Full Jar is €249, and it is the one I recommend. It includes hosting, professional tracking, a sub-domain, and multiple rounds of revisions.
How long does a page take?
Every project is delivered within 24–48 hours. We still start by getting to grips with your offer, audience, and the action you want visitors to take.
Can you work with clients in the UK and Europe?
Yes. I work remotely from Estepona, in Spain, with people across the UK and Europe. Spain is on Central European Time.
Which languages can we work in?
English, Spanish, and Portuguese. This page is in English. We decide the language of your page when we talk.
How do I pay, and when?

Prices are in euros: €99 or €249. I take a credit card through Stripe, an EU SEPA bank transfer, or a UK bank transfer with a sort code and account number. Full payment is required before the project starts.
Yes. I build for mobile, speed, and search foundations. That is part of the page. It is not a promise that you will rank first.
What does hosting include, and who owns the page?
On The Gherkin, hosting is not included. Your page needs a home of its own. On The Full Jar, hosting is included, along with a sub-domain and professional tracking. The page is built for you.
